text: Okay, I see the order details. Yeah, like I said, I want to return it. I found a better deal. So, I want to cancel it. Can you just do that? I don't care what the reason is, just cancel it. I want the full refund on my gift card. That's all.
zh: 好的，我看到了订单详情。是的，就像我说的，我想退货。我发现了一个更好的优惠。所以，我想取消它。你能直接办吗？我不在乎什么原因，直接取消就行。我想要全额退款到我的礼品卡。就这样。
